name: Kawasaki Ninja 400
engine: 399 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: A very common first sport bike. Fully faired, so most jobs start with taking panels off.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2021 Ninja 400s are in recall 20V774 (Kawasaki MC20-13) for a cam chain tensioner that may not have been heat-treated properly. Book any open recall with a Kawasaki dealer.
A-002.reason: A damaged tensioner can stall the engine. Kawasaki told owners not to ride affected bikes until fixed.

recalls.what: Cam chain tensioner may be weak from bad heat treatment and can stall the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the tensioner free (Kawasaki MC20-13).
